title: More than just a coaching tree: Why Sean McVay is so good at forging NFL coaches

sources.title: More than just a coaching tree: Why Sean McVay is so good at forging NFL coaches
sources.description: As Sean McVay enters his 10th season as Rams coach, his former assistants are leading the Packers, Bengals, Vikings, Jaguars and Cardinals as head coaches.
